site.name: Union Trade Inc.
site.address: 333 City Blvd W Ste 1210, Orange CA 92868-5908

observations.title: Failure to develop, maintain, and follow an FSVP
observations.summary: The firm did not develop, maintain, and follow a Foreign Supplier Verification Program for the listed imported foods, including crisp radish, peanuts in shell, and subtropical fruit.

observations.title: Failure to document corrective actions for adulterated dried mushrooms
observations.summary: The firm did not document any corrective actions after discovering dried mushrooms with undeclared sulfites that led to two Class 2 recalls.

observations.title: Failure to conduct or document hazard analyses for imported foods
observations.summary: The firm did not conduct a hazard analysis for each imported food nor document review of a qualified individual's hazard analysis as required.

observations.title: Failure to perform required foreign supplier verification activities
observations.summary: The firm did not document determination or performance of appropriate supplier verification activities for dried mushrooms and lacked written procedures for verification as required.
